requirements.name: EU AI Act Art. 14 - Human Oversight
requirements.description: High-risk AI systems must be designed so that natural persons can oversee them effectively.
requirements.requirement_text: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed so that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.

affected_groups.name: Affected Persons (Non-users)
affected_groups.description: Natural persons subject to decisions of the AI system without interacting with it.
affected_groups.rationale: Applicants are assessed by the system and its output influences access to credit.

vulnerable_groups.name: Persons with Disabilities
vulnerable_groups.description: Persons with physical, mental, intellectual or sensory impairments.
vulnerable_groups.rationale: Proxy discrimination and accessibility barriers may create unequal outcomes.

protected_attributes.name: Disability Status
protected_attributes.rationale: Monitor for direct and proxy discrimination while excluding it from model inputs.

foreseeable_misuse.name: Automation Bias in High-stakes Decisions
foreseeable_misuse.rationale: Operators may treat model recommendations as final decisions.

risk_classification.rationale: Creditworthiness assessment of natural persons is a high-risk use case (Annex III).

human_oversight.rationale: Meaningful review is required before adverse decisions.

assumptions: The organisation acts as provider of the AI system.
